quests.question: Fix: 'I wish I was taller so I could reach the top shelf easily.'
quests.sentence: I wish I was taller so I could reach the top shelf easily.
quests.hint: This expresses a wish about something untrue - the subjunctive mood is needed.
quests.explanation: After 'I wish', use the subjunctive 'were' for hypothetical situations, not 'was': 'I wish I were taller'.
